summary: Access authority request: timeboxed prod log segment for external privacy assessor
description:
Issue summary: External privacy assessment firm (PrivAudit LLC) has requested a scoped sample of production ingestion logs to verify PII minimization and retention profiles. Request includes a 48-hour contiguous segment of API gateway access logs plus associated audit metadata (no raw inference outputs).

Impact: Minimal service impact expected. High compliance risk if access is not authorized correctly or if sensitive customer data is exposed. Customer-facing incidents could result if accidental raw inference output is included.

Request details:
- Requestor: PrivAudit LLC (contract attached to Security ticket SEC-2026-037)
- Data requested: API gateway access logs and associated audit fields (timestamps, request IDs, route, headers summary hash, auth subject) for window 2026-02-10T00:00:00Z to 2026-02-11T00:00:00Z. Explicitly exclude request/response bodies and any unredacted inference outputs.
- Purpose: external verification of anonymization and retention workflows.
- Duration: Access window 72 hours from token issuance. Token must expire automatically and access must be read-only.
- Delivery mechanism proposed: timeboxed S3 presigned URL to a restricted bucket prefix with SSE-KMS encryption using dedicated audit KMS key and enforced ACLs.

Security/controls required:
- Minimization: supply only NDJSON lines with hashed header values (salted HMAC provided by Security) and removed bodies.
- Access control: temporary IAM role scoped to s3:GetObject for the specific prefixed objects; MFA not required for external auditor but access must require a signed presigned URL generated by Security on behalf of Compliance.
- Audit trail: all actions must be recorded in CloudTrail and our internal access-log index; create a monitoring alert for any list/bucket ACL changes.
- Redaction verification: Security to validate redaction script output prior to handing to external party.

Steps for reviewers:
1) Legal/Compliance: confirm contractual permission for third-party access and any DPA amendment needed.
2) Security: review redaction script, generate HMAC salt, approve KMS key usage and presigned URL approach.
3) SRE/Infra: prepare export job to produce NDJSON lines to s3://redwood-prod-audits/tmp/INT-90812/ and create IAM role + presigned URL.
4) Requestor: run validation checklist and confirm no bodies included.

Logs & evidence: Proposed export path will be s3://redwood-prod-audits/tmp/INT-90812/segment-20260210.ndjson.gz (GZIP, line-delimited). Manifest and SHA256 checksum will be provided.

Acceptance criteria:
- No unredacted inference outputs are present in objects.
- Access granted only for the specified path and time window.
- KMS and CloudTrail confirmed for the action.

Additional notes: This is a one-off, timeboxed external audit. Follow-up will include a purge confirmation and a short runbook update to document the steps used.
comments: 2026-02-20 - Priya Nair (reporter): Opening request after Legal confirmed PrivAudit contract. Attaching contract reference SEC-2026-037 and asking Security for redaction guidance.

2026-02-21 - Aisha Khan (Security): We can approve with conditions. We require the redaction pipeline to replace header values with HMAC-SHA256(salt+value) and to remove any request/response bodies. I will generate a per-request HMAC salt and upload to Secrets Manager; will also request a dedicated KMS key alias alias/redwood/audit-int-90812.

2026-02-21 - Samuel Ortega (assignee/SRE): Can produce the NDJSON export once Security validates the script. Proposed export job is a 1-hour EMR spark job to materialize the window and write gzipped NDJSON to s3. ETA to produce sample: 2026-02-22 03:00 UTC.

2026-02-22 - Legal (Monica Ruiz): Confirmed contract permits this specific scope. Please ensure we have the signed SOC addendum on file. Legal requests redaction verification report prior to external delivery.

2026-02-22 - Aisha Khan (Security): Redaction script tested against a synthetic slice and sample manifest uploaded to S3 at s3://redwood-internal-test/INT-90812/sample-manifest.json. No raw inference outputs found in sample. Approving generation and presigned URL approach with KMS alias/redwood/audit-int-90812.
investigation_notes: SRE checked existing retention hooks. Ingestion logs are sharded by day and can be filtered by request_time. Identified ~1.1M lines for the 24h window; expected compressed export size ~180MB gzip. Verified pipeline will exclude bodies by using the 'headers-only' export flag and applying the redaction script as a post-filter. Security will provide HMAC salt and the redaction checklist. No dependency on model-serving traces required.
resolution_notes:
Approved on 2026-02-23 after Security and Legal sign-off. Actions taken: 1) Security created KMS alias/redwood/audit-int-90812 and uploaded HMAC salt to Secrets Manager (rotation note: ephemeral salt for this audit only). 2) SRE generated NDJSON line file at s3://redwood-prod-audits/tmp/INT-90812/segment-20260210.ndjson.gz and provided SHA256 manifest. 3) IAM role 'audit-access-int-90812' created with s3:GetObject limited to the prefix. 4) Security generated a presigned URL valid 72 hours; delivered to PrivAudit via Compliance. 5) CloudTrail export entry created and cross-linked to this ticket.

Follow-ups: create INT-90813 to purge the S3 objects and retire the IAM role after access window closes; Compliance to obtain written confirmation of file destruction from PrivAudit and upload to Confluence.
